verdict: GENE CONTENT. Breadth carries the effect and depth does not, with assembly level, similarity to the reference organism and genome size all held fixed - genome size being the confound that would most easily have manufactured this, and it comes back null - so this is a statement about which complexes acid-tolerant genomes HAVE rather than about how well this panel measures them. It is a finding, and it has been held fixed as a nuisance for two days. Depth behaves exactly as the measurement account predicted it would - it predicts the limit until similarity to E. coli is controlled and then carries nothing - so both halves of the decomposition came out as their accounts said.
